### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/objectql`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s).

**6** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx`  _(via ObjectQLPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/kernel/services-checklist.mdx`  _(via ObjectQLPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/kernel/services.mdx`  _(via ObjectQLPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_

- `content/docs/plugins/packages.mdx`  _(via ObjectQLPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/index.mdx`  _(via ObjectQLPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via ObjectQLPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via ObjectQLPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **19** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 492703e14d50f9a604692519abb43025cd9c2ce1` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `5e95115de695043487f1ff71b72c45332dbe6a67` — the merge of head `7bb6d5326822ee50a5edbfa6553614e22e021579` into base `492703e14d50f9a604692519abb43025cd9c2ce1`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 5e95115de695043487f1ff71b72c45332dbe6a67 && git checkout 5e95115de695043487f1ff71b72c45332dbe6a67
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 492703e14d50f9a604692519abb43025cd9c2ce1 7bb6d5326822ee50a5edbfa6553614e22e021579 && git checkout -B drift-repro 492703e14d50f9a604692519abb43025cd9c2ce1 && git merge --no-ff 7bb6d5326822ee50a5edbfa6553614e22e021579

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 492703e14d50f9a604692519abb43025cd9c2ce1
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 492703e14d50f9a604692519abb43025cd9c2ce1` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

Readings for the seat's three questions on this PR, head 7bb6d532 (test-only push over ba97ffc2). Proposed text for the body's `## Acceptance notes`; the dev writes the body once, so the seat folds it in.

- **(1) Hooks and actions bind once after a reload.** New case in `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack-artifact-reload-registry-refresh.test.ts` ("a reload binds each hook and action once…"): the artifact carries a body hook (`beforeInsert`, appends `stamped` to the input, so a double binding reads `stampedstamped`) and an object-bound script action. At boot and after each of two reloads: one `triggerHooks('beforeInsert')` leaves `stamped`; `listRegisteredActions()` holds the action once; the list read holds one `action` item and one `hook` item of that name. `registerApp` registers collection items into the registry only (by key, replacing); it binds no handler, so the re-registration adds no binding.
- **(2) The object walked twice keeps one contribution.** Same case: `getObjectContributors('arl_note')` is exactly `[com.test.artifact-reload:own:100]` at boot and after each reload; `getPackagedObjectOwner` is the package; the two fields and the one declared index appear once. Both walks register the same package's `own` contribution, which replaces itself.
- **(3) An environment save stays on top.** Existing case ("an environment save of the template still wins…"): `saveMetaItem` (the `PUT /api/v1/meta` body) of `email_template/arl_mail`, then a reload re-registers the package beneath it; list, execution face and by-name all still serve the saved subject.

Runtime pin file: 4 passed (4); eslint and `@objectstack/runtime` typecheck exit 0. On the earlier red `TypeScript Type Check` (run 40891734739): its lanes `typecheck-workspace` and `typecheck-consumers` concluded `cancelled`, not failed (`typecheck-source-gates` and `typecheck-debt` succeeded), consistent with the newer push superseding that head; CI on 7bb6d532 carries the verdict.

## 维护者速读(席位终稿)

- **改了什么**:`os dev` 热重载 artifact 后,引擎把已装的包重新登记一遍,邮件模板、流程、仪表盘、页面、按钮等类型的列表读与发送读都跟上新版本。
- **为什么改**:开发者改了邮件模板源码,按名字读已是新文案,但列表和实际发出的邮件仍是旧文案,要冷重启才生效;流程热重载也绑着旧定义。
- **风险与回滚**:只走开发热重载路径;冷启动与 `PUT /meta` 保存不变,租户保存的条目仍压在包定义上(有测试);hook 与 action 不重复绑定(有测试)。回滚 = 还原 `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` 一处。
- **先看**:`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` 的 `refreshReloadedPackages` 及其在 `metadata:reloaded` 钩子里的调用。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/standalone-stack-artifact-reload-registry-refresh.test.ts`,4 条全绿;删掉钩子里那行调用,第一条转红。
- **需要你做的**:无。非受管面,席位落地。

**席位意见:** ACCEPT。修在根因(重载只重收 object,注册表其余类型停在启动副本),一处调用、一个私有方法,不碰公开面。

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · head `7bb6d5326822ee50a5edbfa6553614e22e021579` · 2026-10-29T15:01Z

- **形态:** 4 files, +449/−0 (`get_files`): `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` +72, two test files, one changeset. No governed path, no `packages/spec`, under 3000 lines ⇒ Tier S, not owed a contract review (no `Clause-②: yes`, no narrowing, no published schema).
- **前提实测:** the claim's correction (`metadata:reloaded` re-ingests objects only; the registry is a boot copy) is what the diff fixes; the dev measured five registry types stale and `object` fresh before the fix, so the scope is every registry-backed type, not `email_template` alone.
- **门禁 check-runs:** 48 on this head: 34 success, 14 skipped, 0 other (read 2026-10-29T15:01Z). `mergeable_state: clean`.
- **抽查读数:** the seat read the `plugin.ts` hunk: re-registration only for packages the registry already holds from `code` / `marketplace`, under the installed source; failures `warn` and keep the previous entries. The three seat questions (double binding, the object walked twice, tenant overlay on top) are answered with tests in `6499700939`, which stands as this PR's Acceptance notes (the relay refuses an unsigned body edit, so they are not folded into the body).
- **接受的偏差:** the attribution line links the card thread, not the seat thread (harness block); `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` not measured locally, green in CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`.
- **散文面:** the changeset's sentences checked against the diff, including "Items removed from the artifact stay registered until restart" (no unregister path in the hunk) and "a disabled package stays disabled" (`installPackage` keeps the lifecycle).
- **范围外去向:** none. `Skills-docs:` not owed (`Metadata-protocol: none`).
- **落地条款:** relay `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the merge queue.
